query FindManyAttachments($filter: AttachmentFilterInput, $orderBy: [AttachmentOrderByInput], $lastCursor: String, $limit: Int, $offset: Int) {
  attachments(
    filter: $filter
    orderBy: $orderBy
    first: $limit
    after: $lastCursor
    offset: $offset
  ) {
    edges {
      node {
        __typename
        createdAt
        createdBy {
          source
          workspaceMemberId
          name
          context {
            provider
            applicationId
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        deletedAt
        file {
          fileId
          label
          extension
          url
          __typename
        }
        fileCategory
        fullPath
        id
        name
        position
        targetAgentChatThreadId
        targetCompanyId
        targetDashboardId
        targetMessageId
        targetNoteId
        targetOpportunityId
        targetPersonId
        targetTaskId
        targetWorkflowId
        updatedAt
        updatedBy {
          source
          workspaceMemberId
          name
          context {
            provider
            applicationId
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
      }
      cursor
      __typename
    }
    pageInfo {
      hasNextPage
      hasPreviousPage
      startCursor
      endCursor
      __typename
    }
    totalCount
    __typename
  }
}
